message: 奇襲

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I feel... dizzy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, you alright, Synn-sama?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's no big deal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You look pale, too. Don't push yourself and get some sleep today.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't do that... starting tomorrow.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Studying a tiny bit at this point ain't gonna change your grades anyway.」
Ah, another wave of dizziness...

name: Paqy
message: 「Studying for tests, doing patrols. Looks like you've even been going to help out at the shopping district sometimes.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's no different from back when I was buried in part-time jobs...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just 'cause you're busy, you haven't been sleeping at all lately, have ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm everyone's Student Council President, after all... this much is only natural...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, if you're fine, that's good, but... it'll all be for nothing if you wreck your health, ya know? It's not like we've got the cash for a hospital stay.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord? That's not a funny joke.」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey! Demon Lord!? Th-This is bad... Hey, snap out of it!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're just asleep!!」
Huh...?
Something soft just touched my lips for a split second!?

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What!?」
I tried to bolt upright, and--
W-W-W-Wait a second, what is this!?
Nanaka is right in front of me.
In all our long, long years together, an unprecedentedly close distance.
And then, the soft, warm sensation pressing against my lips.
W-which means we just.
For just a split second.
The soft, moist, warm sensation against my lips grew even deeper.
Pressed tight together. Mucous membrane pushing against mucous membrane. No, being pushed against.
It was as if Nanaka had deliberately pressed her lips against mine.
It was like a kiss.
A kiss. A kiss. A kiss.
Surely, feeling that way was just my imagination.
It had to have been a trick played by the slight vectors of our bodies' movements, though.
Still, I couldn't move. I couldn't even breathe.
As if a spell had been cast on me. As if I'd been shocked by electricity.
If anything were going to stop, even my heart would have stopped.
After a stretch of time that felt both terribly long and like a mere instant.
Without either of us pulling away first, our lips parted.
The lips right in front of me were slightly wet, glistening in the pale blue winter light.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew...」
The words wouldn't come out.
Even though I had to say something, nothing would come out.

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka! This is, well, um.」
For some reason, I hesitated to call it an accident, yet there hadn't been any strong intention behind it either, nor could I really say it was just how things happened.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-you look like you're doing okay! Ahahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-um, I just wondered if, y-you know, your studying was going well, so I came over, that's all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-is that so. But, um.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's all, that's all, that's really all it is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well, what just happened, uh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You freaked me out lying there collapsed, but you seem fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nana--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I'm gonna head out! Good luck on tomorrow's test too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, wai--」
She left...
I mean.

name: Synn
message: 「What was that...」
No, it was, you know, what you'd call a kiss.
No way, I mean, Nanaka and I aren't like that.
Still, it felt like Nanaka was the one who pressed her lips against mine.
No way.
But it really felt like it. No, impossible. Because we're.
Childhood friends... right?
And yet... why is my heart pounding like this.

name: Synn
message: 「Haahhh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. What's with all the sighing?」
Nanaka and I are....
The sensation lingering on my lips.

name: Paqy
message: 「Oi oi, Synn-sama. Stroking your lips with your fingertips like that is creeping me out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? N-no~~, I was just wondering if they were getting a little dry and chapped.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the heck. Zero romance there. Here I was thinking you were reminiscing about kissing some girl, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-w-w-who are you saying I k-kissed!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, fair point, I guess.」
A kiss.
No, that's wrong. It wasn't intentional. It was just an unexpected accident.
And yet... I can't help picturing that kiss with Nanaka.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, yeah. The air's dry and your lifestyle's a total mess. That's why you pass out flat on your face in the entryway.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you aren't careful, you won't even last until exams are over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haahhh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, you really are acting weird.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm not acting weird at all?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't tell me it's about the entryway.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you holding a grudge 'cause I left you lying there?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's not that--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Couldn't be helped, right? There's no way I could carry you once you collapsed, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know.」
Maybe. Nanaka leaned down to carry me to my room after I collapsed.
And then I suddenly woke up sensing her presence, and our lips...
They were soft. They were warm.
That was a kiss. My first kiss with a girl.
Nanaka and I...

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey! You okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pull yourself together. Exams start tomorrow, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, yeah.」
There's no point thinking about it.
That's right. There's no use thinking about it.
For now, I just...

name: Synn
message: 「I have to study!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's got into you all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「Exams start tomorrow! Let's do this!」
